data.name: Pearl Harbor City Tour / USS Arizona Memorial
data.headline: Step Back in Time: Discover Pearl Harbor and Honolulu’s WWII History
data.description: Step back in time to one of the most significant events in Honolulu’s World War II history. Every visitor to Honolulu should experience the historic sites at Pearl Harbor. Gain a new appreciation for Honolulu’s history as your knowledgeable guide shares important facts about the attack and its role in our country’s development.
data.highlights:
- Transportation to Pearl Harbor Visitor Center
- Tickets for the boat ride to the USS Arizona Memorial
- King Kamehameha Statue photo opportunity
- Honolulu historic landmarks city tour
data.itinerary:
- **USS Arizona Memorial**: Documentary film, ferry ride, memorial visit
- **Hawaii State Capitol**: Historical and political site
- **King Kamehameha Statue**: Photo opportunity
-**Kawaiaha’o Church** Historic Landmarks
- **‘Iolani Palace**: Exterior view from the statue

data.booking_notes:
**PLEASE NOTE** that our buses only pick up from Hotels in the Waikiki/Honolulu area.  If you are staying in a different area, contact us so that we can arrange for you to meet our driver. (808) 495-8693

---------------

### Please make sure that you are at your assigned pickup location at the time indicated on your voucher.

It is vital that we leave Waikiki on time in order to make it to Pearl Harbor on time for the USS Arizona Memorial Ticket times we have secured. Drivers will wait up to 5 minutes for late arrivals at each stop. Refunds are not given for no-shows, so please aim to arrive to your pickup location at least 10 minutes before your assigned pickup. 

Per US Navy Requirements, there are NO BAGS allowed within Pearl Harbor... This includes Camera Bags and Fanny Packs... There are lockers at the welcome center available for $5, but lines are often long, so it is best not to bring bags at all.  Bags cannot be left on the bus. 

If you were given a paper voucher, please bring it with you. If you have an e-ticket, then you can show it to the driver from your phone.

Please allow a 10 min grace period on pick up times due to variable traffic in Waikiki.

Cancellations must be made at least 24 Hours before the activity start time, or no refund will be given.

General Excise Tax of 4.7% and 3% service fee will be added to the retail rate.

The reservations department may contact you to confirm your pickup information before your tour.  Please call us if you have any questions at (808) 495-8693

Mahalo!
